title: Cyber Monday Budget Desk Gear: 3 Picks and What to Check First
excerpt: Three budget desk upgrades worth a look this Cyber Monday: a compact wireless keyboard, a simple wired headset and a gas-spring monitor arm. For each one we list the single thing to check before you buy, so a deal doesn't turn into a return.

sections.title: Quick picks
sections.content:
Sales make it easy to buy the wrong version of the right product. These three picks come from our research reviews: we compiled manufacturer specs, retailer listings and published reviews. Zero Technology has not used these products in person, and each score is an editorial judgement based on published specs, not a lab test.

We don't list deal prices here because we haven't verified them. Prices change by the hour around Black Friday and Cyber Monday, so check the current listing before you buy.

| Pick | What it is | Our score | Check before you buy |
|---|---|---|---|
| [AULA F75 Pro](/reviews/aula-f75-pro) | Compact 75% wireless mechanical keyboard | 8.9/10 | Which switches and keycaps the listing ships with |
| [HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core](/reviews/hyperx-cloud-stinger-2-core) | Simple wired gaming headset | 8.2/10 | Your device has a 3.5 mm jack, and you're buying the right edition |
| [North Bayou F80](/reviews/north-bayou-f80-monitor-arm) | Budget gas-spring monitor arm | 8.0/10 | Monitor weight, size, VESA pattern and desk edge |

sections.title: AULA F75 Pro: compact wireless keyboard
sections.content:
![AULA F75 Pro](/images/products/aula-f75-pro/cover.jpg)

The F75 Pro is a 75% mechanical keyboard with a gasket mount, hot-swap sockets, a volume knob and a 4,000 mAh battery. It connects three ways: USB-C wired, a 2.4 GHz receiver and Bluetooth 5.0. Newegg lists 1,000 Hz polling over wired and 2.4 GHz, and 125 Hz over Bluetooth, so use the receiver for games.

**Check before you buy: the exact version.** The switches change from one version to the next. Newegg's listing says LEOBOG Reaper, while Turbo VS describes Star Vector switches. Keycaps are PBT, but some listings say side-printed and others double-shot. Read the switch name, keycap type and color on the listing you're buying from, not on a photo from a different seller.

- Skip it if you need a numpad, a light travel keyboard (it weighs about 1 kg) or polished software.

[Read the full AULA F75 Pro review](/reviews/aula-f75-pro) · [View a current listing (Newegg, not an affiliate link)](https://www.newegg.com/p/32N-04U2-00679)

sections.title: HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core: simple wired headset
sections.content:
![HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core](/images/products/hyperx-cloud-stinger-2-core/cover.jpg)

The Cloud Stinger 2 Core is HyperX's entry wired headset: 40 mm drivers, a mic that mutes when you swivel it up, a volume control on the ear cup and about 272–275 g of weight (HyperX's pages differ slightly). It plugs in with a 3.5 mm 4-pole CTIA jack, and a splitter is included for PCs with separate mic and headphone ports.

**Check before you buy: your device and the edition.**

- **USB-C-only phones need an adapter.** There's no USB or wireless version of this model.
- **PlayStation and Xbox editions are sold separately.** Our review covers the PC version (683L9AA). Make sure the listing names the edition you want.
- **Price reference:** HyperX's US store listed the PC version at US$29.99 in October 2026. That's a list price from that month, not a Cyber Monday price.

[Read the full Cloud Stinger 2 Core review](/reviews/hyperx-cloud-stinger-2-core) · [View the official HyperX listing (not an affiliate link)](https://hyperx.com/products/hyperx-cloud-stinger-2-core-wired-gaming-headset)

sections.title: North Bayou F80: check compatibility first
sections.content:
![North Bayou F80 monitor arm](/images/products/north-bayou-f80-monitor-arm/cover.jpg)

The F80 is the best-known budget gas-spring arm. It adds height adjustment, portrait rotation and free desk space to a monitor whose stand only tilts. Retailers disagree on its limits, though, so check your setup before you add it to the cart.

**Check before you buy: four things.**

- **Monitor weight, without the stand.** Listings say 2–6.5 kg or 2–9 kg. We treat **6.5 kg as the comfortable limit**. Monitors under about 2 kg can also spring back up.
- **Screen size.** Listings say 17–27 in, 17–30 in or more. A 22–27-inch monitor is the safe range.
- **VESA pattern.** The plate fits 75 × 75 and 100 × 100 mm only. Check the holes on the back of your monitor.
- **Desk edge.** It mounts with a C-clamp or through a grommet hole. North Bayou doesn't clearly publish the maximum desk thickness the clamp supports. Avoid glass, thin or hollow desks, and check for a crossbar under the edge.

Not sure you need an arm at all? Read [Is a Monitor Arm Worth It?](/guides/is-a-monitor-arm-worth-it) first.

[Read the full North Bayou F80 review](/reviews/north-bayou-f80-monitor-arm) · [View a current listing (Newegg Canada, not an affiliate link)](https://www.newegg.ca/north-bayou-f80-monitor-arm-black/p/15Z-0121-00050)

sections.title: Before you check out
sections.content:
Check the current listing for the exact model and price. This guide was last updated on 27 November 2026.

- **Compare model codes, not photos.** Sellers often reuse images across versions.
- **Check the return window.** Holiday return policies vary by store and region.
- **Warranty varies by region.** Check your local retailer for terms.
- **No affiliate links.** Zero Technology doesn't earn anything if you buy through the links on this page. If that changes, we'll say so on the page before the first link.

faq.question: Are these Cyber Monday deal prices?
faq.answer: No. We don't list deal prices we haven't verified. The only price on this page is HyperX's US list price from October 2026. Check the current listing for today's price.

faq.question: Has Zero Technology tested these products?
faq.answer: No. All three are research reviews based on published specs, retailer listings and other reviewers' findings. The scores are editorial judgements, not lab results.

faq.question: Which AULA F75 Pro version should I buy?
faq.answer: Pick the one whose listing clearly names the switch (for example LEOBOG Reaper or Star Vector) and the keycap type. If the listing doesn't say, ask the seller before you buy.

faq.question: Does the HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Core work with an iPhone or Android phone?
faq.answer: Yes, if the phone has a 3.5 mm jack. USB-C-only phones need a USB-C to 3.5 mm adapter with mic support.

faq.question: Will the North Bayou F80 hold my monitor?
faq.answer: Probably, if it's a 22–27-inch monitor with VESA 75 or 100 that weighs about 2–6.5 kg without its stand, and your desk edge is solid. Heavier screens and ultrawides need a stronger arm.

faq.question: Do I need all three?
faq.answer: No. Each pick fixes a different problem: desk space and typing feel, voice chat, or screen height. Start with the one that bothers you most every day.
